correctness.rationale: Proof checked: each support has (q−1)^|F| weights and rank at most twice its maximum matching. Pfaffians for a unicyclic graph have at most two terms, because symmetric difference of perfect matchings is the unique even cycle. If an extremal matching does not internally match the entire cycle, a unique-monomial maximal Pfaffian remains nonzero; otherwise all maximal Pfaffians share the same two-cycle product difference. Exactly 1/(q−1) of full-support assignments cancel, and removing endpoints of a cycle edge preserves a unique-forest Pfaffian one rank-step below. Orbit-method count for odd fields follows from radical dimension n−2j. Independent brute weighted rank enumeration matched the formula on 4-cycle and triangle-with-leaf for q=2,3. No representation claim for q even.
